name: Crater Walker V3 · Difficulty 5 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Hover over the dust patches on the overhead chart to survey concealed plates and their live forecasts. Surveyed plates stay visible. Survey before WAKE to prepare safely; after WAKE the crater keeps moving during inspection. Wake the crater. Shift the gold weight handle so the body stays inside the support polygon, then move each colored toe to its next numbered plate. A foot stroke takes one second; aim for the future location shown by its 1/2/3-second dashed trail. Feet stick to their moving supports, and the body keeps momentum. The lift channel follows the next terrace height; you choose the horizontal landing coordinate. Match the toe to its own next plate with its whole small footprint inside the ring. A missed landing, exhausted extension or full TOPPLE bar ends the episode. Press Escape to cancel a held aim before release; cancellation is harmless; certification before escape fails. Drag the gold weight handle and drag a colored toe to its landing coordinate. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
